```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(plyr)
library(reshape2)
library(doBy)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# marine Isotope Stage
# Odd number = warmer period or inter-glacial period
# even number = colder period or glacial period
# https://www.researchgate.net/figure/Abbreviations-MIS-Marine-Isotope-Stages-c-cold-w-warm-hor-Horizon-Intergl_fig1_336150437

# https://lorraine-lisiecki.com/LR04_MISboundaries.txt?fbclid=IwAR0QYZdQvJTZt8wdc-VWZD2flFGrx_aMyjYxTk49Czo9bnwrX2hB9yIWdu8
mis <- read_excel("../../Data/LR04_MISboundaries.xlsx", sheet=1)[-5:-9,]
mis <- mis[1:53,]

mis <- mis[-3:-4,]
mis[2, 2] <- "2-4"
mis[2, 4] <- 123

mis$Period <- c(rep(c("Interglacial",	"Glacial"), 25), "Interglacial")
mis$Period <- factor(mis$Period, levels=c("Interglacial",	"Glacial"))
```

# Sample information

```{r}
dat <- read_excel("../../Data/20220419 MD012414 diatom all.xls", sheet = 1) %>% as.data.frame
sam <- dat[, 1:3]
names(sam) <- c("depth_cm", "corrected_depth_cm", "Age_ka")

# Marine Isotope Stage
sam$MIS <- cut(sam$Age_ka, breaks=c(0, mis$End), labels = mis$MIS, right=FALSE)
sam <- cbind(sam, mis[match(sam$MIS, mis$MIS), -1:-2])

# Mid-Pleistocene Transition
sam$Period2 <- cut(sam$Age_ka, breaks=c(0, 830, 1230, 1600), labels = c("Post", "MPT", "Pre"), right=FALSE)
sam$Period2 <- factor(sam$Period2, levels=c("Pre", "MPT", "Post"))

# Interglacial vs. super interglacial
sam$Period3 <- sam$Period %>% as.character
sam$Period3[sam$MIS==5|sam$MIS==9|sam$MIS==11|sam$MIS==31|sam$MIS==47|sam$MIS==49] <- "Super interglacial"
sam$Period3 <- factor(sam$Period3, levels=c("Interglacial", "Super interglacial",	"Glacial"))

# Raw species count 
spp <- dat[, c(-1:-3, -55:-57)] 
row.names(spp) <- sam$Age_ka
spp[is.na(spp)] <- 0  # Set NA to zero
spp <- ceiling(spp) # Covert decimal values (only a few) to whole numbers
zero <- rowSums(spp)==0 # The sample with zero count
```

A total of 130 samples, primarily collected during MPT, have zero abundance. As a result, these samples are considered to have zero diversity. Therefore, their species evenness cannot be estimated and they are omitted from calculation.

```{r}
cbind(sam, TotalAbudnace=rowSums(spp))[zero,] %>% kable %>% kable_classic
```


# Ancillary data

```{r}
# Wet bulk density (g/cm^3)
wbd <- read_excel("../../Data/MD01-2414_Wet-bulk-density.xlsx", sheet = 2) %>% as.data.frame
out <- approx(wbd$`age 20160429`, wbd$`WBD [g/cm**3]`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$WBD <- out$y

# Sedimentation rate (cm/kyr)
sr <- read_excel("../../Data/MD01-2414-age-model-report_290416.xlsx", sheet = 2, n_max = 66) %>% as.data.frame
out <- approx(sr$`Time (ka)`, sr$`Rate (cm/kyr)`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$SR <- out$y

# Diatom concentration (valves/g)
dc <- read_excel("../../Data/20241007-diatom-concentration.xlsx", sheet = 1) %>% as.data.frame
out <- approx(dc$Age..ka., dc$`Diatom conc. (valves/g)...5`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$DC <- out$y

# Diatom accumulation rate (valves/cm^2/yr)
sam$DAR <- sam$DC*sam$WBD*sam$SR/1000
sam$logDAR <- log10(sam$DAR)

# d18o
sr <- read_excel("../../Data/MD01-2414-age-model-report_290416.xlsx", sheet = 2) %>% as.data.frame
out <- approx(sr$`Time (ka)`, sr$d18O, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$d18O <- out$y

# Coarse fraction (%)
cf <- read_excel("../../Data/Ancillary/MD01-2414-CF_final_20151012.xlsx", sheet = 1) %>% as.data.frame
out <- approx(cf$`age 20160429`, cf$CF, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$CF <- out$y

# Sea surface temperature (degree C)
tex86 <- read_excel("../../Data/Ancillary/TEXBIT-Okhotsk_20160428.xlsx", sheet = 1, skip = 1, n_max = 382)[,-1:-13] %>% as.data.frame
# Linear interpolation
out <- approx(tex86$age_20160429, tex86$`SST-L...17`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$SST <- out$y

# Total organic carbon (mol/kg) & flux (gC cm^-2 kyr^-1)
ea <- read_excel("../../Data/Ancillary/MD01-2414-EA-data.xlsx", sheet = 1, skip = 2, n_max = 378) %>% as.data.frame
out <- approx(ea$`Age (ka)`, ea$`TOC (mol/kg)`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$TOC <- out$y
out <- approx(ea$`Age (ka)`, ea$`TOC (gC cm-2 kyr-1)`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$TOC_F <- out$y

# Total inorganic carbon (mol/kg) & flux (gC cm^-2 kyr^-1)
out <- approx(ea$`Age (ka)`, ea$`TIC (%)`*10/12.011, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$TIC <- out$y
out <- approx(ea$`Age (ka)`, ea$`TIC (gC cm-2 kyr-1)`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$TIC_F <- out$y

# Total nitrogen (mol/kg) & flux (gN cm^-2 kyr^-1)
out <- approx(ea$`Age (ka)`, ea$`TN (mol/kg)`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$TN <- out$y
out <- approx(ea$`Age (ka)`, ea$`TN (gN cm-2 kyr-1)`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$TN_F <- out$y

# C/N ratio
out <- approx(ea$`Age (ka)`, ea$`C/N (mol/mol)`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$CN <- out$y

# Total phosphate (mmol/kg) & flux (gP cm^-2 kyr^-1)
P <- read_excel("../../Data/Ancillary/MD012414-P-data.xlsx", sheet = 2, skip=1, n_max = 509)[,1:16] %>% as.data.frame
names(P) <- paste(read_excel("../../Data/Ancillary/MD012414-P-data.xlsx", sheet = 2, n_max = 0)[,1:16] %>% names(), names(P))
out <- approx(P$`Age (ka)_202208 ...4`, P$`TP (mmol/kg)...10`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$TP <- out$y

# Calculate total phosphate flux (gP cm^-2 kyr^-1)
# Total phosphate (mmol/kg) * 0.030973761 (g/mmol) / 1000 g/kg  * Wet bulk density (g/cm^3) * Sedimentation rate (cm/kyr)
sam$TP_F <- sam$TP*0.030973761/1000*sam$WBD*sam$SR

# Organic phosphate (mmol/kg)
out <- approx(P$`Age (ka)_202208 ...4`, P$`Org-P (mmol/kg)...9`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$OrgP <- out$y

# Total inorganic phosphate (mmol/kg)
out <- approx(P$`Age (ka)_202208 ...4`, P$`TIP-P (mmol/kg)...8`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$TIP <- out$y

# Detrital phosphate (mmol/kg)
out <- approx(P$`Age (ka)_202208 ...4`, P$`Det-P (mmol/kg)...7`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$DetP <- out$y

# Sterol data
st <- read_excel("../../Data/Ancillary/MD01-2414 Sterol Data.xlsx", sheet = 1, skip = 2) %>% as.data.frame

# 24-Methylenecholesterol (ng/g sed.) & flux (g cm-2 kyr-1)
out <- approx(st$`Age (ka)...3`, st$`24-Meth. (ng/g sed.)`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$Meth <- out$y
out <- approx(st$`Age (ka)...3`, st$`24-Meth. (g cm-2 kyr-1)`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$Meth_F <- out$y

# Brassicasterol (ng/g sed.) & flux (g cm-2 kyr-1)
out <- approx(st$`Age (ka)...3`, st$`Brass. (ng/g sed.)`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$Brass <- out$y
out <- approx(st$`Age (ka)...3`, st$`Brass. (ng cm-2 kyr-1)`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$Brass_F <- out$y

# β-Sitosterol (ng/g sed.) & flux (g cm-2 kyr-1)
out <- approx(st$`Age (ka)...3`, st$`B-sito. (ng/g sed.)`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$Bsito <- out$y
out <- approx(st$`Age (ka)...3`, st$`B-sito. (ng cm-2 kyr-1)`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$Bsito_F <- out$y

# Campesterol (ng/g sed.) & flux (g cm-2 kyr-1)
out <- approx(st$`Age (ka)...3`, st$`Camp. (ng/g sed.)`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$Camp <- out$y
out <- approx(st$`Age (ka)...3`, st$`Camp. (ng cm-2 kyr-1)`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$Camp_F <- out$y

# Stigmasterol (ng/g sed.) & flux (g cm-2 kyr-1)
out <- approx(st$`Age (ka)...3`, st$`Stigma. (ng/g sed.)`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$Stigma <- out$y
out <- approx(st$`Age (ka)...3`, st$`Stigma.(ng cm-2 kyr-1)`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$Stigma_F <- out$y

# Dinosterol (Relative ratio) & flux (Relative ratio)
out <- approx(st$`Age (ka)...3`, st$`Dino. (Relative ratio)...21`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$Dino <- out$y
out <- approx(st$`Age (ka)...3`, st$`Dino. (Relative ratio)...29`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$Dino_F <- out$y

# Vascular (ng/g sed.) & flux (g cm-2 kyr-1)
out <- approx(st$`Age (ka)...3`, st$vascular, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$Vascular <- out$y
out <- approx(st$`Age (ka)...3`, st$`Vascular flux`, sam$Age_ka, rule = 2)
sam$Vascular_F <- out$y
```

save(mis, file="../Rdata/mis.rda")
save(spp, file="../Rdata/spp.rda")
save(sam, file="../Rdata/sam.rda")
